MaskStrategy: Mask computation strategy, trading build time against per-token latency.
MaskStrategy.AUTO: Automatic selection: `PARSER_DWA`, or the retained `TOKEN_CLASS_TRIE` when one is available.
MaskStrategy.PARSER_DWA: Static masks: slowest build, fastest per-token masks.
MaskStrategy.TOKEN_TRIE: Trie walk per mask: fastest build.
MaskStrategy.TOKEN_CLASS_TRIE: Trie walk over token equivalence classes.
BoundaryMaskStrategy: Boundary parser selection for crossings between composed grammars.
BoundaryMaskStrategy.PARSER_DWA: Static boundary parser; faster crossings. An over-budget build raises ValueError.
BoundaryMaskStrategy.AUTO: Automatic selection: `PARSER_DWA`, falling back to `TOKEN_TRIE` when the static boundary parser declines on budget.
BoundaryMaskStrategy.TOKEN_TRIE: Segmented dynamic boundary token walk; faster build.
Token:
An original model token ID without vocabulary identity.

Only ID membership is checked against the target vocabulary, so the same ID can refer to different bytes. Use `vocab.tokens([id])` for a vocabulary-bound singleton.
Token.__init__: Creates a token event for `id`; membership is checked at compile.
ExactTokens:
One token event chosen from a vocabulary-bound set.

Vocabularies must have the same ID-to-byte mapping and exact-only IDs, even for a singleton. An empty set matches nothing.
ExactTokens.ids:
The exact model token IDs, sorted in ascending order.

Materializes the IDs; use `ranges` to inspect large sets.
ExactTokens.ranges:
The normalized, disjoint token-ID ranges.

Each `range` has an exclusive stop.
ExactTokens.__len__: Number of allowed token IDs, not the number of ranges.
Vocab:
The model vocabulary a constraint is compiled against.

Entries map model token IDs to exact token bytes. Token IDs may be sparse; masks use the original model token IDs.
Vocab.from_dict:
Creates a vocabulary from `{token: id}`.

String tokens are UTF-8 encoded and byte tokens are used verbatim; IDs must be unsigned 32-bit integers.
Vocab.from_id_to_bytes:
Creates a vocabulary from `{token_id: bytes}`.

Use the tokenizer's exact decoded bytes, including partial UTF-8 sequences, not display spellings.
Vocab.from_llama_cpp:
Creates a vocabulary from a llama-cpp-python `Llama`.

EOG, control, unused, and empty-piece tokens are omitted from byte matching; use `llama_cpp_end_token_ids` for the root stopping policy.
Vocab.llama_cpp_end_token_ids: EOG IDs discovered by `from_llama_cpp`; pass them as `end_tokens` when compiling.
Vocab.tokens:
Creates a vocabulary-bound token event matching one of `ids`.

Unknown or duplicate IDs raise `ValueError`; empty input matches nothing.
Vocab.token_ranges:
Creates a vocabulary-bound token event matching the union of `ranges`.

Ranges are nonempty Python ranges with step 1 or -1 and exclusive stops; overlapping or adjacent ranges merge. Unknown IDs raise `ValueError`; empty input matches nothing.
Vocab.__len__: Number of byte-backed entries; exact-only IDs are not counted.
Extern: A declared extern slot on a `Grammar` or `Module`.
Extern.name: The declared name.
Extern.kind: The declared kind: token or grammar.
Externs:
A view over a `Grammar`'s or `Module`'s declared externs, in declaration order.

Implements `collections.abc.Mapping`.
Externs.unbound: The same view restricted to unresolved externs.
Externs.__getitem__: The extern for `key`; raises `KeyError` if absent.
Externs.__iter__: The declared extern names in declaration order.
Externs.__len__: Number of externs in this view.
Externs.__eq__: Compares the externs in declaration order.
Expr: An immutable unordered union or concatenation of independently scoped grammars.
Expr.choice:
Creates a union without ordered-choice priority.

An empty choice matches nothing; open parts raise `ValueError` immediately.
Expr.sequence:
Creates a concatenation; a model token may cross any number of operand boundaries.

An empty sequence is epsilon; open parts raise `ValueError` immediately.
Expr.literal:
Matches exact bytes, with no whitespace or ignore inserted.

`str` is UTF-8 encoded.
Module:
A reusable grammar with bindings and any retained compilation work.

May still have unresolved externs.
Module.__init__: Creates a module from a source grammar.
Module.bind:
Binds the extern `name` to `value`; the keyword form binds several atomically, and none is applied if any fails.

Fails if an extern is undeclared or already bound; names containing `::` are rejected.
Module.precompile:
Retains vocabulary-specific compilation artifacts for this module.

The strategies decide which static parts are built. A module resolved to `TOKEN_TRIE` retains no work and compiles from source.
Module.compile:
Compiles the module assembly against `vocab`.

Requires every extern to be bound; `end_tokens` are allowed only at acceptance and must be committed before stopping. The strategies apply to the whole compile, including every composed child, and never downgrade a part that already has a static preparation.
Module.externs: A view over the module's declared externs, in declaration order.
Module.copy: An independent snapshot sharing immutable source and retained work.
Module.save: Serializes the module assembly and any retained precompiled artifacts.
Module.load: Deserializes a module assembly, verifying it against `vocab` when supplied.
Grammar:
The source-language definition, without compilation settings.

Source text is parsed lazily, so parse errors surface at compile time.
Grammar.from_ebnf: Creates a grammar from EBNF source text.
Grammar.from_glrm:
Creates a grammar from GLRM source.

GLRM supports typed extern slots; bind them before compiling a runnable root.
Grammar.from_json_schema:
Creates a grammar from a JSON Schema document.

Accepts JSON text or a JSON-serializable object; `format` is an annotation only.
Grammar.from_lark:
Creates a grammar from Lark source.

Named token atoms declare token externs; bind each through `Module.bind`.
Grammar.externs: A view over the grammar's declared externs, in declaration order.
Grammar.precompile:
Retains vocabulary-specific compilation artifacts and returns the module.

Equivalent to `Module(self).precompile(vocab, ...)`.
Grammar.compile:
Compiles the grammar against `vocab`.

Equivalent to `Module(self).compile(vocab, ...)`.
Constraint:
A fully runnable grammar compiled against a specific vocabulary.

Immutable and safe to share; each `start()` creates independent mutable state.
Constraint.start: Creates independent state for one generated sequence.
Constraint.mask_len: Number of packed `u32` words in a mask, for `fill_mask`; not the Boolean-array length returned by `mask`.
Constraint.save:
Serializes the constraint, including its vocabulary and root stopping policy.

With `external_vocab=True`, load with `Constraint.load(data, vocab)` using the exact original token-ID/byte mapping, not merely the same size. Artifact compatibility across GLRMask releases is not guaranteed.
Constraint.load:
Deserializes a constraint.

`vocab` is required for artifacts saved with `external_vocab=True` and must match the original mapping. Rejects malformed or incompatible artifacts.
ConstraintState: The mutable state for a single generated sequence.
ConstraintState.clone: An independent snapshot at the current prefix.
ConstraintState.mask:
The current allowed-token mask as a new Boolean array indexed by original token ID.

`size` must cover the constraint's whole token range; extra positions are false.
ConstraintState.fill_mask:
Writes the current mask into a contiguous, writable 1-D NumPy `int32` array.

The array must hold at least `Constraint.mask_len()` words; extra words are cleared.
ConstraintState.commit_token:
Commits one model token event.

Unknown IDs raise `ValueError`; forbidden IDs reject the state and may also raise. Committing after an end token raises.
ConstraintState.commit_bytes:
Commits raw bytes rather than a model token event.

Does not substitute for committing exact-token or end-token events.
ConstraintState.is_accepting:
Whether the current prefix is a complete grammar match.

Further tokens may still be allowed; this alone does not commit an end token.
ConstraintState.is_rejected: Whether the prefix cannot be extended to a valid match.
ConstraintState.forced_tokens:
A read-only prefix of library-canonical forced output, at most 10,000 IDs.

Uses the longest admitted nonempty token spelling, then the lowest original token ID; exact-token events retain their IDs. The query stops at root acceptance or an ambiguous event boundary.
ConstraintState.marker_events:
Initial or most recent commit's observations as `(marker_id, absolute_byte_offset)`.

Sorted by offset then ID; a failed commit clears the batch and mask or forcing queries leave it unchanged.
auto:
Adaptive JSON Schema policy inspection and persisted tier selection.

For ordinary compilation, prefer `Grammar.compile(..., mask_strategy=MaskStrategy.AUTO)`. Policy thresholds are empirical choices, not latency guarantees. All tiers inherit the JSON Schema importer's partial assertion support.
auto.AutoSchemaShape:
Source-shape counts used by the policy, not a schema validation result.

`json_bytes` measures normalized JSON serialized with sorted keys and compact separators.
auto.json_schema_auto_shape: Extracts the policy's source-shape features from JSON text or a JSON-serializable schema.
auto.select_json_schema_auto_tier:
Selects `o1`, `o2`, or `o3` from fitted source-shape thresholds.

The choice predicts a compile/mask trade-off; it does not guarantee a latency bound.
auto.AutoConstraint:
Constraint wrapper that records the selected tier and policy.

Its artifact carries the tier, so loading does not rerun selection. JSON Schema assertions unsupported by the importer may remain unenforced.
auto.AutoConstraint.__init__: Use `from_json_schema` for normal construction; unknown tier names raise `ValueError`.
auto.AutoConstraint.from_json_schema:
Chooses a tier and compiles.

Accepts schema text or an object; inherits the importer's partial JSON Schema support.
auto.AutoConstraint.load:
Restores the recorded tier.

Rejects missing or unknown artifact tags; the supplied vocabulary must match the original.
auto.AutoConstraint.save: Includes the tier tag and the underlying constraint artifact.
auto.AutoConstraint.start: Independent decoding state with the same mask/commit interface as `ConstraintState`.
auto.AutoConstraint.mask_len: Number of packed `u32` words in a mask.
auto.AutoSchemaShape.json_bytes: Bytes of normalized compact JSON with sorted keys.
